opportunities.title: Small Research Grants

next_open_date.raw: No specific next open date mentioned

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from all countries globally. Projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: We support projects where there is a clear ecological science focus to the work; any other aspects, i.e. sociology, economics, etc., must be clearly integrated into the ecology and scientific goals of the project.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

next_open_date.raw: No specific next open date mentioned

amount.raw: Up to £500 for in-person events, up to £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: PhD students and postgraduate researchers. Work or study at a university or research institution. Work in scientific areas within our remit (the science of ecology) and of relevance to the training course or meeting they are applying to attend.
opportunities.summary: These grants help PhD students and postgraduate researchers to meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to network and publicise their research by presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Citizens of and based in the Global South. Must be a BES member and have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: This grant supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK.
